title: pinus mugo subsp. mughus
intro: Pinus mugo subsp. mughus, commonly known as Alpine Mugo Pine or Dwarf Mountain Pine, is a subspecies of evergreen coniferous tree in the pine family. It is native to the European Alps and is prized for its small size, dense branches, and fragrant foliage. The health benefits of Pinus mugo subsp. mughus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat respiratory issues, skin conditions, and wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
